requirements.title: Integrity and ethical values
requirements.text: Set expectations for ethical conduct and communicate them to staff and contractors. Evidence: code of conduct, acknowledgements, and investigation records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC1.1

requirements.title: Board oversight
requirements.text: Provide independent oversight of internal control over security. Evidence: board or committee charter, minutes, and oversight reports.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC1.2

requirements.title: Management structure and authority
requirements.text: Define reporting lines, authority, and responsibilities for security work. Evidence: organization chart, delegations, and role descriptions.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC1.3

requirements.title: Competence
requirements.text: Require the skills needed for security roles and support their development. Evidence: job requirements, training records, and performance reviews.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC1.4

requirements.title: Accountability
requirements.text: Hold individuals accountable for security responsibilities and measure performance. Evidence: objectives, performance reviews, and corrective actions.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC1.5

requirements.title: Quality information
requirements.text: Use relevant and accurate information to operate and monitor security controls. Evidence: data sources, quality checks, and management reports.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC2.1

requirements.title: Internal communication
requirements.text: Communicate security responsibilities and expectations across the organization. Evidence: policies, briefings, and acknowledgement records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC2.2

requirements.title: External communication
requirements.text: Communicate with customers, partners, and regulators about security matters as required. Evidence: communication channels, notices, and inquiry logs.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC2.3

requirements.title: Objectives and risk identification
requirements.text: Define security objectives and identify risks that could prevent their achievement. Evidence: objectives, risk register, and assessment records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC3.1

requirements.title: Risk analysis
requirements.text: Analyze identified risks for likelihood and impact, and decide how to respond. Evidence: risk scoring method, risk register, and treatment plans.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC3.2

requirements.title: Fraud risk
requirements.text: Consider the potential for fraud when assessing risks to security objectives. Evidence: fraud risk assessment and management review.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC3.3

requirements.title: Changes in risk
requirements.text: Reassess risk when the business, technology, or threat environment changes. Evidence: change impact assessments and updated risk records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC3.4

requirements.title: Ongoing and separate evaluations
requirements.text: Evaluate controls through continuous monitoring and periodic independent reviews. Evidence: monitoring reports, internal audit results, and test scripts.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC4.1

requirements.title: Communication of deficiencies
requirements.text: Report control deficiencies to those responsible and track remediation. Evidence: issue register, remediation plans, and closure evidence.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC4.2

requirements.title: Control activities selection
requirements.text: Select controls that mitigate the risks identified for security objectives. Evidence: control matrix and risk-to-control mapping.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC5.1

requirements.title: Technology general controls
requirements.text: Rely on properly designed and operating technology controls, including infrastructure and processes. Evidence: technology control test results and system inventories.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC5.2

requirements.title: Policies and procedures
requirements.text: Document policies and procedures and keep them current and available. Evidence: policy library, version history, and review approvals.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC5.3

requirements.title: Logical access security
requirements.text: Protect systems and data with logical access controls across software, infrastructure, and architecture. Evidence: access control design, identity configuration, and test results.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC6.1

requirements.title: User registration and authorization
requirements.text: Register and authorize new internal and external users before access is granted. Evidence: onboarding tickets, approvals, and user listings.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC6.2

requirements.title: Role-based access and least privilege
requirements.text: Assign access by role and limit it to what the role requires. Evidence: role definitions, entitlement mappings, and access reviews.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC6.3

requirements.title: Physical access to facilities
requirements.text: Restrict physical access to facilities that host or support systems and data. Evidence: badge lists, visitor logs, and access reviews.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC6.4

requirements.title: Access removal
requirements.text: Remove logical and physical access promptly when people leave or change roles. Evidence: termination tickets, deprovisioning logs, and badge returns.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC6.5

requirements.title: External threats
requirements.text: Protect against threats that originate outside the system boundary. Evidence: boundary diagram, firewall rules, and intrusion alerts.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC6.6

requirements.title: Information transmission and removal
requirements.text: Restrict transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized channels. Evidence: transfer policy, encryption settings, and exception approvals.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC6.7

requirements.title: Malicious software
requirements.text: Prevent, detect, and respond to unauthorized or malicious software. Evidence: endpoint controls, application allowlists, and malware alerts.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC6.8

requirements.title: Configuration and vulnerability management
requirements.text: Detect configuration drift and vulnerabilities, and correct them on a defined schedule. Evidence: baselines, scans, and remediation records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC7.1

requirements.title: Monitoring
requirements.text: Monitor system components for anomalies that indicate security incidents. Evidence: monitoring coverage, alert rules, and response tickets.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC7.2

requirements.title: Incident identification
requirements.text: Evaluate security events to decide whether they are incidents and assign severity. Evidence: triage records, severity guide, and incident log.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC7.3

requirements.title: Incident response
requirements.text: Execute the incident response plan and communicate with affected parties. Evidence: incident plans, response timelines, and communications.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC7.4

requirements.title: Incident recovery
requirements.text: Recover from incidents and confirm that systems and data are restored correctly. Evidence: recovery plans, restoration tests, and closure reports.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC7.5

requirements.title: Change management
requirements.text: Authorize, design, test, approve, and implement changes through a controlled process. Evidence: change tickets, approvals, test results, and deployment logs.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC8.1

requirements.title: Risk mitigation
requirements.text: Identify and implement mitigation for business disruption and security risks. Evidence: risk treatment plans, insurance, and continuity arrangements.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC9.1

requirements.title: Vendor risk management
requirements.text: Assess and monitor vendors and business partners that could affect security objectives. Evidence: vendor inventory, due diligence, and contract reviews.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), CC9.2

requirements.title: Capacity management
requirements.text: Monitor and manage capacity so systems meet availability commitments. Evidence: capacity plans, utilization reports, and scaling records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), A1.1

requirements.title: Backup and recovery
requirements.text: Maintain backups and recovery arrangements that meet availability objectives. Evidence: backup schedules, off-site copies, and restore test reports.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), A1.2

requirements.title: Recovery testing
requirements.text: Test recovery plans periodically and correct failures found in exercises. Evidence: exercise plans, results, and follow-up actions.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), A1.3

requirements.title: Processing objectives
requirements.text: Define what complete, valid, accurate, timely, and authorized processing means for the service. Evidence: processing objectives and service specifications.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), PI1.1

requirements.title: Input controls
requirements.text: Validate inputs so processing uses complete and accurate data. Evidence: input validation rules, error reports, and reconciliation.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), PI1.2

requirements.title: Processing controls
requirements.text: Monitor processing for errors and exceptions, and resolve them. Evidence: job monitoring, exception queues, and correction records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), PI1.3

requirements.title: Output controls
requirements.text: Verify that outputs are complete, accurate, and delivered to authorized recipients. Evidence: output reconciliation and distribution records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), PI1.4

requirements.title: Stored data integrity
requirements.text: Protect stored data from unauthorized or accidental alteration and loss. Evidence: integrity checks, access controls, and restore records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), PI1.5

requirements.title: Confidentiality identification and retention
requirements.text: Identify confidential information and retain it only as long as needed. Evidence: data inventory, retention schedule, and disposal records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), C1.1

requirements.title: Confidentiality disposal
requirements.text: Dispose of confidential information securely when it is no longer required. Evidence: disposal procedure and destruction certificates.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), C1.2

requirements.title: Privacy notice
requirements.text: Tell data subjects what personal information is collected and how it is used. Evidence: privacy notice, publication record, and change history.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P1.1

requirements.title: Choice and consent
requirements.text: Offer and record choices about the collection, use, retention, and disclosure of personal information. Evidence: consent flows and consent records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P2.1

requirements.title: Collection limited to objectives
requirements.text: Collect personal information only for the purposes described in the notice. Evidence: data inventory and collection-point review.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P3.1

requirements.title: Lawful and fair collection
requirements.text: Collect personal information by lawful and fair means. Evidence: collection procedures and legal basis records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P3.2

requirements.title: Use limited to objectives
requirements.text: Use personal information only for identified purposes and any consent obtained. Evidence: purpose mapping and access review records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P4.1

requirements.title: Retention
requirements.text: Retain personal information only as long as the stated objectives require. Evidence: retention schedule and purge reports.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P4.2

requirements.title: Disposal
requirements.text: Dispose of personal information securely when retention ends. Evidence: disposal procedure and destruction logs.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P4.3

requirements.title: Access by data subjects
requirements.text: Let authenticated data subjects access their personal information and learn whether it is held. Evidence: request workflow and response records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P5.1

requirements.title: Correction
requirements.text: Correct, amend, or append personal information on request and notify relevant third parties. Evidence: correction requests and propagation records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P5.2

requirements.title: Disclosure with consent
requirements.text: Disclose personal information to third parties only with consent or another stated basis. Evidence: disclosure register and consent records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P6.1

requirements.title: Authorized disclosure records
requirements.text: Keep complete and accurate records of authorized disclosures. Evidence: disclosure log and reconciliation.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P6.2

requirements.title: Unauthorized disclosure records
requirements.text: Record detected or reported unauthorized disclosures and their handling. Evidence: incident register and breach investigation files.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P6.3

requirements.title: Vendor privacy commitments
requirements.text: Obtain privacy commitments from vendors and other third parties that handle personal information. Evidence: contract clauses and vendor assessments.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P6.4

requirements.title: Vendor breach notification
requirements.text: Require vendors to notify the organization of actual or suspected unauthorized disclosures. Evidence: contract terms and notification test records.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P6.5

requirements.title: Breach notification
requirements.text: Notify affected data subjects, regulators, and others when a breach requires it. Evidence: notification procedure and breach notices.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P6.6

requirements.title: Accounting of disclosures
requirements.text: Provide data subjects with an accounting of personal information held and disclosed. Evidence: request workflow and disclosure reports.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P6.7

requirements.title: Data quality
requirements.text: Keep personal information accurate, current, and complete for its intended use. Evidence: quality checks, correction requests, and reconciliation.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P7.1

requirements.title: Privacy monitoring and enforcement
requirements.text: Monitor privacy compliance, handle complaints, and apply consequences for violations. Evidence: complaint log, investigation records, and disciplinary actions.
requirements.sourceRef: AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, revised 2022), P8.1
